environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Quarkus native compiled) deployed in a VPC with an S3 Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0x8f3a2b1c). The endpoint has a custom policy document that enforces a condition: aws:PrincipalOrgID must match the organization AND the s3:prefix condition key must begin with 'uploads/${aws:userid}/' for PutObject actions. Additionally, the endpoint policy includes a StringNotLike condition on s3:ObjectKey denying any key containing path traversal sequences ('..') or null bytes. The Lambda subnet route table directs all S3 traffic (prefix list pl-63a5400a) exclusively through this VPC endpoint - there is no NAT gateway or internet gateway route for S3 CIDR ranges. The bucket itself has a bucket policy with a Deny statement for any s3:PutObject where aws:sourceVpce does not equal vpce-0x8f3a2b1c, ensuring no bypass via alternative network paths.

config.route_table: pl-63a5400a -> vpce-0x8f3a2b1c (no igw/nat for S3 CIDRs)
